description: A finite Horn theory containing only definite rules has its forward closure as a model, contained in every other model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.definite_least_model.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) (hd : ∀ r ∈ Γ, r.head ≠ none) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ ↑(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ) ∧
    ∀ (Y : Set α),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ Y →
        ∀ p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ, p ∈ Y
